description.html: The 80x40x45 cm terrarium has 3200 cm² of floor and 144 liters. On the back is a 3D styrofoam background, and ventilation is through a mesh vent. A length of 80 cm is the size at which the warm and cool zones already separate clearly. The 45 cm height leaves room for a lamp and a branch.

An adult kingsnake has a permanent home here, with a hide at each end and a background for climbing. A ball python of smaller build uses the floor and a low branch. Growing Hermann's and Horsfield's tortoises and a young blue-tongued skink get 80 cm for walking. A bearded dragon is 20 cm of length short of the minimum for an adult.

The 100x40x40 +3D model has those 20 cm, with the same width. The 80x50x50 offers a wider floor on the same length. You choose the shape of the background before the build, and we make changed dimensions in 7 to 14 days. The terrarium arrives by courier with the background installed.
